title: Horizontal pasting for fixed normalized proper/open comparisons
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring. Use bounded-below derived etale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], exact open extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], proper maps [def-weil-proper-morphism] and open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. For every commutative proper/open square fix ordinary natural isomorphisms delta:i_!r_*≅p_*k_! and derived natural isomorphisms gamma:i_!Rr_*≅Rp_*k_!. Assume that for each square k:A→B, i:C→D, r:A→C, p:B→D with k p=r i, delta_F followed by p_*(k_!F→k_*F) and the compositor k_*p_*→(k p)_* equals i_!r_*F→i_*r_*F followed by the compositor r_*i_*→(k p)_*. Assume also that gamma.hom is exactly rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange(delta.hom). Then gamma obeys horizontal pasting, with the extensionZeroCompDerivedPlusIso compositors [cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change]. The equation, with all compositors and orientations, is specified verbatim in the Lean record. Only equalities of these fixed maps are concluded; this statement neither constructs the comparison isomorphisms nor asserts their identity or refinement/base-change laws.

proof.text: Apply the proved ordinary_horizontal lemma from EtaleProperOpenHorizontalNormalization to the two squares and the outside square, using the three instances of hδ. This gives delta_outer followed by q_* of the open-extension compositor equal to the lower compositor followed by j_!(delta_1) and delta_2. Cancel q_* of the invertible top compositor to express the pasted natural transformation as the outside transformation transported along the inverse top and bottom compositors.

proof.text: Use the existing source-library rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_naturality on the preceding transported ordinary equation, and rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_paste on the two adjacent deltas. Substitute hγ for the three given gamma maps. Unfold only extensionZeroCompDerivedPlusIso, compose the naturality equation with the exact derived composition isomorphisms, cancel their hom/inv pairs, and apply the derived pasting equation. The remaining hom/inv pair cancels, giving the displayed equality at each K. These generic APIs are completely proved in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.RightDerivedFunctor.PlusBaseChangeNaturality; no new derived-functor statement is assumed.

theorem properOpenInterchangeHorizontalPasting_of_normalization (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
  [Finite Λ]
    (δ : ∀ {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (k : A ⟶ B) (i : C ⟶ D) (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ D) [IsOpenImmersion
        k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i), (lowerStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r) ⋙ (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i) ≅
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k) ⋙ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p))
      (γ : ∀ {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (k : A ⟶ B) (i : C ⟶ D) (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ D) [IsOpenImmersion
        k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i),
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).rightDerivedFunctorPlus) ⋙ (openImmersionLowerShriek
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ≅ (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u +
        1} Λ) k).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙ ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          p).rightDerivedFunctorPlus))
    (hδ : (∀ {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (k : A ⟶ B) (i : C ⟶ D) (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ D)
      [IsOpenImmersion k]
        [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i), ∀ (F : (Sheaf
        A.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))),
      (δ k i r p h).hom.app F ≫ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).app F) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k p).hom.app F =
      (openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).app ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u +
        1} Λ) r).obj F) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r i (k ≫ p) h).hom.app F))
    (hγ : ∀ {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (k : A ⟶ B) (i : C ⟶ D)
      (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ D) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i),
      (γ k i r p h).hom = Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange (δ k i r p h).hom) :
    (∀ {A B C D E F : Scheme.{u}}
      (k : A ⟶ B) (l : B ⟶ E) (i : C ⟶ D) (j : D ⟶ F)
      (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ D) (q : E ⟶ F)
      [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion l] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
      [IsProper r] [IsProper p] [IsProper q]
      (h₁ : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (h₂ : l ≫ q = p ≫ j)
      (h : (k ≫ l) ≫ q = r ≫ (i ≫ j))
      (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf A.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))),
      (extensionZeroCompDerivedPlusIso Λ i j).hom.app (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        r).rightDerivedFunctorPlus).obj K) ≫
        (γ (k ≫ l) (i ≫ j) r q h).hom.app K ≫
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q).rightDerivedFunctorPlus).map
          ((extensionZeroCompDerivedPlusIso Λ
        k l).inv.app K) =
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map ((γ k i r p
        h₁).hom.app K) ≫
        (γ l j p q h₂).hom.app ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        k).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))
